metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Apurv Bazari

plugins.name: onboard
plugins.description: Writes Claude tooling for your repo, a project .mcp.json included; offers plugins, installs only the ones you accept.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for Claude Code on macOS and Linux: an alert with repo, branch and a short excerpt of Claude's reply when a task finishes or Claude needs you, with a cooldown so rapid replies don't spam you.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Saves where a session left off and offers it at the next start. Nothing runs until you choose what to do.

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: Render a session or any subject (plugin, marketplace, path) as a self-contained interactive HTML document that loads nothing from the network

plugins.name: lens
plugins.description: Review Claude's work against the spec and plan it was meant to follow: checks the session's changes, verifies each finding, and writes an interactive review. Never edits your code.
